available_evidence: The intake method prioritizes fast landing, honest provisional metadata, recoverability, and later enrichment.
Title, date, host, voice, source shape, and routing may be inferred when signals are strong.
Ambiguity can create misleading metadata or duplicate source identities before any file is written.
The operator-facing workflow has both implementation names and compatibility aliases.
Existing source-state counts do not reveal attempts stopped as duplicates, failures, retries, or corrections.
decision_prompt: Propose a bounded intake hardening change. State expected benefit, principal risk, falsifier, and the attempt-level measurement needed before claiming improvement.

evaluation_points: creates stable source identity and duplicate stops
separates control availability from production outcome
